program.name: Boxing and Bells
program.subject: Boxing
program.blurb: Bouts, then strength with weights: kettlebell power one day, dumbbells the next.
program.about: Boxing with the strength behind the punches. Each day is a long block of bouts, then weights: swings, cleans and push presses one day, rows, presses and rotational core with dumbbells the next. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Both later levels bring longer combinations and harder moves.
program.split: Bouts & bell power / bouts & dumbbell strength
